question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id
    FROM pizza_clean_runner_orders
    WHERE cancellation IS NULL OR cancellation = ''
),
order_pizzas AS (
    SELECT co.order_id, co.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    INNER JOIN delivered_orders dord ON co.order_id = dord.order_id
),
pizza_toppings_list AS (
    SELECT op.order_id, op.pizza_id, pr.toppings
    FROM order_pizzas op
    INNER JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON op.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
split_toppings AS (
    SELECT order_id, pizza_id, CAST(TRIM(value) AS VARCHAR) AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_toppings_list,
         UNNEST(string_split(toppings, ',')) AS _t(value)
)
SELECT pt.topping_name, COUNT(*) AS quantity
FROM split_toppings st
INNER JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON st.topping_id = CAST(pt.topping_id AS VARCHAR)
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY quantity DESC
